id: E-5 (a helper whose parent is pid 1 anchors on CLAUDE_PID under MSYS and Cygwin)
note: Under Git Bash a hook's perl sees getppid() = 1, so the walk to Claude Code started at pid 1, found nothing and took pid 1: every by-pid record (classic-alive.json, sessions, locks) named pid 1. Under MSYS and Cygwin, when the walk starts at pid 1 or below, Claude Code's own CLAUDE_PID is now the anchor; without it the helper stays degraded as before. On other systems a helper whose parent is pid 1 is an orphan, and a CLAUDE_PID it still carries may name a process that has exited, so it keeps pid 1 as before. STORE_TEST_PPID stands in for getppid() and STORE_TEST_OS for the system. The runner stands in for Claude Code (CLAUDE_PID = the runner's pid, no STORE_TEST_CLAUDE_PID)

steps.name: MSYS, parent pid 1, CLAUDE_PID set: the records name Claude Code, not pid 1
Cygwin, parent pid 1, CLAUDE_PID set: the same
MSYS, parent pid 1, no CLAUDE_PID: degraded as before (pid 1)
macOS or Linux, parent pid 1 (an orphan), CLAUDE_PID set: pid 1 as before
